title: Yangtze River
html:
Yangtze River is an Asian river map added to OpenFront in Update 34.0 by crunchybbb — an upside-down-U-shaped pipe river map following the lower Yangtze from Nanjing to the Shanghai delta.

Nations

The map features 9 named nations, including Shanghai, Taizhou, Nantong, Changzhou, Nanjing and Wuhu.
